GPT Image 2 + Seedance 2.0 on @yapper_so 

SEEDANCE 2.0:
Style & Mood: Deep charcoal and cool slate palette with precise rim lighting and volumetric studio fill. ARRI Alexa Mini LF with 85mm cinema glass renders denim indigo with micro contrast precision, while macro optics reveal thread-level detail. The mood evolves from intimate product reverence to urban energy, then returns to refined stillness.

Narrative Summary: A light blue washed denim Nike Air Force 1 Low moves from an unboxing ritual into urban motion and returns to a pristine hero portrait.

Dynamic Description: Hands lift a matte black Nike shoe box from darkness as the camera pushes toward the embossed logo. The lid opens and the sneaker slides into view, rotating through raking studio light that reveals every denim thread. Cut to a static 85mm beauty shot where the sneaker rests on a clean surface under sculpted lighting that emphasizes denim texture and form.

A macro orbital move circles the blue denim Swoosh in slow motion, woven fibers drifting through focus. A macro tilt moves from white laces down to the toe box, highlighting stitching and perforations. A slow push-in lands on the heel tab as rim light reveals the NIKE AIR embroidery.

The shoe appears on foot with a white crew sock in a low angle lifestyle frame. A hard cut drops to floor level as the outsole impacts a wet reflective surface in ultra slow motion, water expanding outward at the beat drop. A handheld pavement tracking shot follows the sneaker across wet urban stone, conveying speed and weight.

A stabilized low angle tracking shot climbs concrete stairs with the athlete. The frame widens into a running sequence through a blurred urban corridor, keeping the sneaker sharp against motion streaks. The scene transitions into a fully stabilized 360 degree orbit around the shoe suspended in a white studio volume with volumetric light columns.

A macro frame fills with the outsole pattern as a slow tilt reveals the complete sole geometry. The camera then captures the sneaker crashing into water in extreme slow motion, creating a symmetrical splash frozen in time. The final shot settles into a static 85mm hero composition with warm rim light deepening the denim indigo while a slow pullback reveals elegant negative space.

Static Description: Locations progress from a dark studio void to a clean product surface, macro bokeh environment, low key lifestyle set, wet reflective studio floor, wet urban pavement, concrete stairs, motion blurred city corridor, floating white studio volume, and a final warm lit hero stage.

Props include a matte black Nike shoe box, Nike Air Force 1 Low in light blue washed denim, blue denim Swoosh, white laces, white perforated toe box, white inner lining, white Air Force sole, Nike Air heel embroidery, white crew sock, wet pavement, concrete stairs, and reflective water surfaces.

Ambient details include thread-level denim texture, tactile embroidery depth, outsole geometry, reflective urban surfaces, suspended water droplets, soft studio highlights, and controlled rim lighting that emphasizes the premium denim construction throughout.
content:
Specify Style & Mood with an exact color palette plus lighting cues (e.g., deep charcoal/cool slate, precise rim lighting, volumetric studio fill) to lock in a consistent cinematic look in Seedance 2.0.

Add real-world camera and lens details in the prompt (ARRI Alexa Mini LF, 85mm cinema glass, macro optics) to steer framing, depth of field, and texture rendering.

Write a shot-by-shot Dynamic Description that explicitly names camera moves (push-in, static 85mm beauty shot, macro orbital, macro tilt, handheld tracking, stabilized tracking, 360° orbit, slow pullback) to control motion and pacing.

Call out material-detail targets (thread-level denim texture, micro-contrast, embroidery depth, outsole geometry, suspended droplets) to force high-detail closeups and macro realism.

Maintain product consistency by explicitly instructing “use the exact same sneaker across every frame” and listing fixed identifiers (light blue washed denim, blue denim Swoosh, white thick sole, white perforations, white laces/lining, Nike Air heel embroidery only) plus exclusions (no Levi’s logo, no red tags, no distortion).

Define video specs in the prompt (16:9, 4K HDR, 24fps with 120fps slow motion moments) to guide format and where slow-motion should appear.

Use a storyboard workflow: generate a 15-panel 3×5 16:9 storyboard sheet with scene descriptions first (via GPT Image 2), then use those panels as the plan for Seedance shots to keep narrative continuity.

Sync action beats to music by explicitly placing events on “beat drop” moments (e.g., outsole impact on wet reflective surface at the beat drop) to align edits and motion accents.

Include negative constraints to prevent common failures (do not overexpose denim texture, avoid shaky camera, avoid distracting backgrounds, keep text minimal/readable, no low quality footage).

Usa un flujo de trabajo de storyboard: genera una hoja de storyboard de 15 paneles 3×5 16:9 con descripciones de escenas primero (a través de GPT Image 2), luego usa esos paneles como el plan para las tomas de Seedance para mantener la continuidad narrativa.

---
Spécifiez le style et l'humeur avec une palette de couleurs exacte plus des indices d'éclairage (par exemple, charbon profond/ardoise froide, éclairage de bord précis, remplissage volumétrique de studio) pour verrouiller un look cinématographique cohérent dans Seedance 2.0.

Ajoutez des détails réels de caméra et d'objectif dans le prompt (ARRI Alexa Mini LF, verre cinéma 85mm, optiques macro) pour orienter le cadrage, la profondeur de champ et le rendu de la texture.

Écrivez une Description Dynamique plan par plan qui nomme explicitement les mouvements de caméra (push-in, plan beauté statique 85mm, orbite macro, inclinaison macro, suivi à main levée, suivi stabilisé, orbite 360°, retrait lent) pour contrôler le mouvement et le rythme.

Indiquez les cibles de détails matériels (texture de denim au niveau du fil, micro-contraste, profondeur de broderie, géométrie de la semelle extérieure, gouttelettes suspendues) pour forcer des gros plans détaillés et un réalisme macro.

Maintenez la cohérence du produit en instruisant explicitement "utilisez exactement la même basket dans chaque cadre" et en listant les identifiants fixes (denim bleu clair lavé, Swoosh en denim bleu, semelle épaisse blanche, perforations blanches, lacets/doublure blancs, broderie Nike Air au talon uniquement) plus les exclusions (pas de logo Levi’s, pas d'étiquettes rouges, pas de distorsion).

Définissez les spécifications vidéo dans le prompt (16:9, 4K HDR, 24fps avec des moments au ralenti à 120fps) pour guider le format et où le ralenti doit apparaître.

Utilisez un flux de travail de storyboard : générez une feuille de storyboard 3×5 16:9 de 15 panneaux avec des descriptions de scènes d'abord (via GPT Image 2), puis utilisez ces panneaux comme plan pour les prises Seedance pour maintenir la continuité narrative.

Synchronisez les temps forts de l'action avec la musique en plaçant explicitement les événements sur les moments de "chute de rythme" (par exemple, impact de la semelle sur une surface réfléchissante mouillée au moment de la chute de rythme) pour aligner les montages et les accents de mouvement.

Incluez des contraintes négatives pour éviter les échecs courants (ne pas surexposer la texture du denim, éviter la caméra tremblante, éviter les arrière-plans distrayants, garder le texte minimal/lisible, pas de séquences de mauvaise qualité).

编写逐镜动态描述，明确命名相机移动（推进，静态85mm美丽镜头，微距轨道，微距倾斜，手持跟踪，稳定跟踪，360°轨道，慢拉回）以控制运动和节奏。

指出材料细节目标（线级牛仔布纹理，微对比，刺绣深度，鞋底几何，悬浮水滴）以强制高细节特写和微距真实感。

在prompt中定义视频规格（16:9，4K HDR，24fps带120fps慢动作时刻）以指导格式和慢动作出现的位置。
